description: Delays an incoming gate and re-times it to a width you set

params.text: How long a gate is held back before it comes out, 0 to 5 seconds, at 0.1 seconds by default
Scales the DELAY CV before it is added to the knob, -1 to +1
How long the delayed gate stays high, 0 to 5 seconds, at 0.1 seconds by default
Scales the WIDTH CV before it is added to the knob, -1 to +1
Fires one gate into the delay by hand, with no cable patched

inputs.text: A rising edge here starts one delayed gate; the two GATE IN jacks are summed, so an edge on either one starts it
Modulates the delay time, scaled by the attenuverter and added to the knob
Modulates the gate width, scaled by the attenuverter and added to the knob

outputs.text: The delayed gate, 10V for the length set by WIDTH
